findings.message: Two different things are called 'the note'. In the locker, Ivy takes 'the note' off the tag (story.r6.json, passage locker, paragraph 4). The locked hint and choice label at threshold say 'the last log note'. A young reader could mix them up. Suggest 'the tag' in the locker.

The locked choice 'open-careful' has a hint ('Find a long pole and read the last log note first.'), but by that point no route lets the reader go back. They must replay from the start. That is fair for a replayable story, and nothing forces backtracking, but the hint could say it is for the next read.
The passage title 'The Door Hisses' differs from the ending title 'Too Fast' (passage title, and ending.title in ending-rush). Cosmetic; make them match.

I could not run 'npm run check' here; the shell refused it for approval. The pass rests on the validation report (schema ok, 5/5 endings reachable, literacy checks ok, brief ok) and my own reading of the JSON. Run 'npm run check' before relying on this review.
